subject.title: fix(security): bound plugin manifest reads in audit deep scan

question: Should deep audit treat plugin manifests larger than 1 MiB as unparseable and continue with directory-only scanning?
rationale: The threshold trades bounded resource use against manifest-declared entrypoint coverage for unusually large valid manifests.

options.title: Accept bounded coverage
options.body: Keep the 1 MiB limit, warning, and directory-only scan for oversized manifests.

options.title: Preserve declared-entry coverage
options.body: Require a different bounded extraction design if all declared skipped-path entries must remain force-scanned.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded coverage
recommendation.body: Keep the 1 MiB limit, warning, and directory-only scan for oversized manifests.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the changed security path to this team.
